generate_nbest_translations: generate n-best translations using a trained fairseq model with beam search and BPE processing
rerank_translation_hypotheses: rerank translation hypotheses using multiple scoring models with left-to-right and right-to-left approaches
preprocess_bitext_data: preprocess and binarize source-target bitext data for reranking with custom dictionary files
apply_bpe_encoding: apply byte pair encoding to source and target translations using subword-nmt for rescore data
run_reranking_pipeline: run the complete reranking pipeline with n-best generation, preprocessing, and binarization steps
